description: Look up a Windows driver hash in the LOLDrivers catalog of vulnerable and malicious drivers. Block on the file and Authenticode hashes, not on the detection rules. For many hashes, call driver_lookup_bulk. Source: LOLDrivers (Apache-2.0).

file_hash.description: MD5, SHA1 or SHA256 of the driver file, or its Authentihash: 32, 40 or 64 hex digits, either case

include_commands.description: true adds the catalog's command text to each match

name: driver_lookup
title: Windows Driver Lookup (LOLDrivers)
